styleSuffix: CURATION (verbatim on every item): photographed, not rendered — the frame must read as a real capture. Off-center, asymmetric framing; one clear light direction with honest falloff; true blacks that are slightly lifted, never crushed; restrained saturation, colour held near the neutral axis except one accent; visible material truth — grain, dust, fingerprints, wear, chipped edges, uneven surfaces; fine 35mm film grain, heavier in the shadows, almost absent in the highlights; depth of field that comes from a real lens, not a pasted blur. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numerals, no signage, no watermarks, no logos or trademarks, no UI chrome, no faces, no plastic or waxy sheen, no perfect bilateral symmetry, no oversaturation, no HDR halo, no fake bokeh, no lens-flare stickers, no vignette baked in.

groupSuffix.cine: GENRE STYLE — CINEMATIC: anamorphic 40mm at f/2.8, single practical light source plus one soft bounce, atmosphere carrying the light (dust, haze, steam, rain), cool shadows against one warm source, wide frame with the subject small in it, deep field.
groupSuffix.grid: GENRE STYLE — RANGE TILE: one idea per frame, read clearly at 480px wide; strong figure-ground separation; the subject occupies the middle third; background simplified to two values.
groupSuffix.seq: GENRE STYLE — SEQUENCE FRAME: identical location, identical props, identical lens (35mm at f/4); only the stated camera position, hour and light change between frames; horizon and floor line held constant.
groupSuffix.ba: GENRE STYLE — PAIR: the two frames share subject, placement and framing exactly; only fidelity and finish differ.
groupSuffix.mat: GENRE STYLE — MACRO: 100mm macro at f/8, raking light across the surface from one side, the plane nearly filling the frame, focus falling off at the far edge, texture legible down to the fibre.
groupSuffix.prod: GENRE STYLE — PRODUCT: 90mm tilt-shift at f/5.6, large softbox from camera-left with a black flag on the right, one honest specular highlight, contact shadow grounded on the surface, seamless sweep with a visible seam.
groupSuffix.arch: GENRE STYLE — SPACE: 24mm shift lens, verticals held true, one directional daylight source and its cast geometry, human scale implied by furniture and door height, no people.
groupSuffix.abs: GENRE STYLE — ABSTRACT MATERIAL: studio light on a physical substance, not a digital effect; shot on a copy stand; the frame reads as a photograph of something real that happens to look abstract.
groupSuffix.fig: GENRE STYLE — FIGURE WITHOUT FACE: the person is turned away, cropped at the shoulders, or reduced to a silhouette; 85mm at f/2, natural window light, fabric and hair rendered strand by strand.
groupSuffix.amb: GENRE STYLE — AMBIENT: near-dark frame, one small warm source deep in the scene, most of the image in the low tones, wide and quiet, built to sit under text.

note: image-batch.mjs appends spec.styleSuffix only. Before planning, run the expand step in docs/research/higgsgen-imageset-2026-09-03.md §B.3 so each item's prompt becomes prompt + groupSuffix[group] + styleSuffix. Items with refs:true must be planned as a SEPARATE /v1/images/edits batch (one endpoint per batch).

items.prompt: A flooded concrete underpass at dawn, ankle-deep still water holding the whole ceiling as a mirror. A single sodium lamp burns at the far end. Wet stains, rebar shadows, one drifting plastic bag. Wide, camera low and close to the water, the vanishing point pushed hard right so the left third stays empty for a headline.

A high-altitude research shelter on volcanic gravel, orange corrugated steel scoured by wind, guy-wires humming, cloud shearing past below the ridge. Late afternoon sun raking from camera-right. The shelter sits small in the lower-right quadrant; sky and cloud own the rest.

The interior of a disused indoor swimming hall, drained, tiles cracked, mid-morning light falling through a clerestory in hard rectangles across the empty basin. Dust suspended in the beams. Symmetry deliberately broken by a single displaced starting block.

A greenhouse at night in winter, glass fogged from inside, grow-lamps pushing magenta through condensation, snow banked along the outside sill. Shot from outside looking in through the fog, foliage only readable as silhouette and colour.

A salt flat at blue hour after rain, a hairline crack pattern under two centimetres of water, a distant storm cell lit from within on the right horizon. Nothing else in the frame. Ground and sky split at the lower third.
A cast-iron radiator painted over eleven times, paint chipped down through the strata, against a mint-green wall in flat afternoon light.
A stack of wet ceramic tiles on a workshop floor, seen from above at a slight angle, water pooling under the bottom edge.
A single-lane mountain road switchback in fog, guardrail beaded with condensation, the road disappearing after twenty metres.
A tangle of climbing rope on a bare plywood bench, one strand frayed, hard window light from the left.
A 1970s municipal library reading room, empty, warm oak and brown carpet, low winter sun crossing the tables.
Three cuts of raw ginger and a wet knife on a scarred wooden board, overhead, one bulb above.
A wind turbine nacelle seen from directly below at close range, blades cropped by the frame edges, overcast white sky.
A cracked leather jacket sleeve draped over a chair back, the creases holding the shape of an arm, side light.
A dry riverbed in late summer, pale rounded stones, one steel bridge pier planted in the middle distance, heat shimmer.
A sheet of dew on a car roof at sunrise, the droplets holding inverted images of a bare tree, macro-ish but showing the whole panel.
A theatre fly loft from the stage floor looking up, ropes and counterweights, one working light burning.
A pile of blue nylon fishing net on a wet concrete quay, coiled, rope ends fused by heat.

items.prompt: Unglazed porcelain at the point where a thumb pressed the wet clay, the fingerprint ridges fired in.
Brushed titanium with a hairline scratch pattern running one way and a single deeper gouge running across it.
Raw linen weave at the seam where two panels meet, one thread pulled proud of the surface.
Split oak end-grain, the rays and a resin bleed, saw-tooth marks still on the face.
Hand-blown glass at a bubble trapped mid-wall, the light bending around it, the surface faintly rippled.
Cold-rolled steel beginning to rust at a weld bead, orange bloom spreading into blue-grey.
A matte black cylindrical desk speaker on a pale concrete sweep, three-quarter view, its fabric grille catching one raking highlight, contact shadow tight beneath it.
A stainless vacuum flask standing on wet slate, condensation beading, one cool rim light describing the edge, background falling to near-black.
An open leather notebook lying flat on linen, pages fanned by a breeze, a brass pen resting across the gutter, soft overhead light.
A pair of wired studio headphones hung from a steel hook against a plaster wall, cable falling in one natural loop, hard side light.
A ceramic pour-over cone on a glass carafe, a thin stream of water mid-fall, steam bending right, dark grey sweep behind.
A long concrete corridor with a clerestory slot running its whole length, the light landing as one unbroken band on the opposite wall, doors set flush and unmarked.
A timber-framed attic conversion, rafters exposed and stained dark, a low window at floor level throwing a trapezoid of light across bare boards.
A public swimming pool changing hall in pale terrazzo, benches in a row, one skylight per bay, cool north light, wet footprints leading out of frame.
A stairwell in a 1960s housing block seen straight up from the ground floor, the flights spiralling into a bright square at the top, paint peeling at the rail.
Black ink dropped into a tank of clear glycerine, photographed as the plume unfolds, backlit, most of the frame empty.
Iron filings pulled into field lines on a sheet of frosted glass, lit hard from one side so each filing casts a shadow.
Cigarette smoke crossing a single shaft of light in a dark room, the shaft entering from the upper left, the rest near-black.
Cracked dry mud lifted into curling plates, shot from directly above at grazing light, the cracks reading as a network.
A soap film stretched across a wire loop, interference colours banding as it thins, black background.
Long-exposure water over dark stone, the flow smoothed to a single grey ribbon, everything else sharp.
A person seen from directly behind at a workbench, head cropped above the frame line, shoulders in a worn cotton shirt, hands out of view, window light from the left.
A silhouette standing in a doorway against a bright exterior, the figure entirely black, the door frame and its wear fully lit.
A pair of hands cropped at the wrists resting on a stone table, skin texture and one old scar, low warm light.
A person walking away down a corridor, back turned, motion blur in the legs, the camera static and the walls sharp.
A darkened studio after hours, one desk lamp burning far back on the right, the rest of the room reading in three low values, the left two-thirds empty.
A night highway seen from a hillside, one string of tail lights curving away, the land black, the sky just holding blue.
A window at night from inside an unlit room, city glow only, condensation on the glass, the room reduced to edges.
